record.name: 共鸣回响·梦魇亚当·重锤

skill.descTemplate:
使用声骸技能，对范围内敌人造成总共十六段{2}的物理伤害。
在首位装配该声骸技能时，若装配角色为露西或丽贝卡，则自身暴击提升{4}，且声骸技能也将根据其装配角色替换为对应的特殊效果。
若装配角色为露西，则声骸技能替换为：
·短按声骸技能，对周围敌人造成{0}的衍射伤害。
·长按声骸技能，对周围敌人造成{0}的衍射伤害，并进入特殊的移动状态，持续期间提高露西的移动速度并减缓周围敌人的时间流速。
若装配角色为丽贝卡，则声骸技能替换为：
·使用声骸技能，发射导弹，对敌人造成十六段{1}的导电伤害。
技能冷却：{3}秒

skill.descEnRank5:
Cast Echo Skill to deal 16 instances of Physical DMG equal to 10.26% of ATK to enemies within range.
When Lucy or Rebecca has this Echo equipped in the main slot, their Crit. Rate is increased by 15% and they unlock special Echo Skills.

If equipped by Lucy:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 273.60% of ATK to nearby enemies.
- Hold the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 273.60% of ATK to nearby enemies and enter a special moving state, increasing Lucy's movement speed while slowing nearby enemies.

If equipped by Rebecca:
- Cast Echo Skill to fire missiles, dealing 16 instances of Electro DMG equal to 17.10% of ATK to enemies.
CD: 20s
